Zuma (recompiled) - public build - EARLY BRING-UP
Xbox 360 / XBLA (2005, PopCap / Oberon Media) statically recompiled for PC. No
game data is included - no content package, no game executable, no images, no
audio; you must own the game and supply your own copy. This build does contain
the game's own program code, recompiled, so it is only for people who own the
game: do not redistribute it.
Releases, source and bug reports: https://github.com/springah/zuma_recomp

STATUS - READ THIS FIRST
  This port boots to the title screen ("PRESS A TO START") and stays alive
  there. Everything past the title is UNTESTED and expected to break. The
  useful test is simply: does it reach the title on your PC, and what happens
  when you press A. A crash with its log attached is a GOOD result for this
  build - that is exactly what it is out to find.

ADD YOUR GAME
  Zuma is an XBLA title, so there is no disc. What you need is the LIVE /
  STFS content package for the game, copied off your OWN Xbox 360's storage.
  On the console it sits at
    Content\0000000000000000\584107EF\000D0000\<40 hex digits>
  (a file with no extension and a long hexadecimal name; its first four bytes
  are the letters LIVE). Then, with Python 3 installed:

    Windows:  drag the package onto extract_game.bat
              (or copy it into this folder and double-click extract_game.bat)
    Others:   python3 extract_game.py "<path to your package>"

  That unpacks the package into assets\ next to zuma.exe - the whole package,
  not just default.xex, because the game reads its data from that folder. If
  the extractor says the file "is not an Xbox 360 LIVE/STFS package", you
  pointed it at the wrong file: most likely an already-extracted default.xex
  rather than the package that contains it.

  Already have the package extracted? Put its contents in assets\ so that
  assets\default.xex and the rest of the files sit directly inside it.

TO PLAY
  Once assets\ is populated, double-click zuma.exe. It auto-loads the assets\
  folder next to it. A window opens (1920x1080 windowed by default; the game
  itself renders at 1280x720 and is scaled to fit). Logs go to logs\ next to
  the exe.

REQUIREMENTS
  - Windows 10/11 x64 with a Direct3D 12 GPU
  - Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64):
      https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe

CONTROLS
  An Xbox controller works out of the box. Press F4 for the settings overlay to
  see and rebind controls (keyboard included) and change display settings;
  "Save to config" writes zuma.ini for you.

SETTINGS AND LOGS
  Edit zuma.ini next to the exe (window size, fullscreen, vsync, upscaler, log
  level), then restart - it is read at startup. "vsync = true" (the default)
  locks the game to your monitor's refresh and presents without tearing; on a
  variable refresh rate display you can keep the pacing but let the window
  present immediately again with "present_vsync = false" in the F4 cvar list.
  Logs are written to logs\zuma_NNN.log next to the exe.

BUG REPORTS
  Open an issue at https://github.com/springah/zuma_recomp/issues. Say what
  you did (did it reach the title? did you press A? what happened?) and attach
  the newest file from logs\.

  THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt beside this file.
